requirements.quote: [MQTT-4.6.0-6]	When a Server processes a message that has been published to an Ordered Topic, it MUST follow the rules listed above when delivering messages to each of its subscribers.
requirements.condition: When a Server delivers an Ordered Topic message to each subscriber.
requirements.required_behavior: Follow the ordering rules listed above this statement.
requirements.why_checkable: The referenced rules are not included in this chunk, so the required behavior cannot be enumerated from this evidence alone.

requirements.quote: In addition it MUST send PUBLISH packets to consumers (for the same Topic and QoS) in the order that they were received from any given Client.
requirements.condition: When a Server sends consumers multiple PUBLISH packets with the same Topic and QoS that were received from one Client.
requirements.required_behavior: Send them in the order in which they were received from that Client.
requirements.why_checkable: Server receipt order and per-consumer send order can be compared using distinct messages.

requirements.quote: [MQTT-4.7.1-1]	The wildcard characters can be used in Topic Filters, but MUST NOT be used within a Topic Name.
requirements.condition: When parsing an otherwise valid Topic Filter containing a wildcard character.
requirements.required_behavior: Permit the wildcard in the Topic Filter.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Reject it solely because a valid wildcard is present.
requirements.why_checkable: Topic Filters containing # or + can be submitted and parsed.

requirements.quote: [MQTT-4.7.1-1]	The wildcard characters can be used in Topic Filters, but MUST NOT be used within a Topic Name.
requirements.condition: When constructing or accepting a Topic Name.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Include wildcard characters within the Topic Name.
requirements.why_checkable: Topic Names containing # or + can be submitted and checked for rejection.

requirements.quote: [MQTT-4.7.1-2]	The multi-level wildcard character MUST be specified either on its own or following a topic level separator.
requirements.condition: When # appears in a Topic Filter.
requirements.required_behavior: Place it either as the entire filter or immediately after a topic level separator.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Embed # after a non-separator character.
requirements.why_checkable: Standalone, slash-prefixed, and embedded # placements can be classified.

requirements.quote: In either case it MUST be the last character specified in the Topic Filter.
requirements.condition: When # appears in a Topic Filter.
requirements.required_behavior: Make # the final character of the Topic Filter.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Place any character after #.
requirements.why_checkable: Filters with trailing characters after # can be tested for rejection.

requirements.quote: [MQTT-4.7.1-3]	The single-level wildcard can be used at any level in the Topic Filter, including first and last levels.
requirements.condition: When + occupies a Topic Filter level, including the first or last level.
requirements.required_behavior: Permit + at that level.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Reject it solely because it is first or last.
requirements.why_checkable: Filters with + at first, interior, and last levels can be submitted.

requirements.quote: Where it is used it MUST occupy an entire level of the filter.
requirements.condition: When + is used in a Topic Filter.
requirements.required_behavior: Make + the sole character in its topic level.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Combine + with other characters in the same topic level.
requirements.why_checkable: Whole-level and embedded + placements can be parsed and classified.

requirements.quote: [MQTT-4.7.2-1]	The Server MUST NOT match Topic Filters starting with a wildcard character (# or +) with Topic Names beginning with a $ character.
requirements.condition: When a Topic Filter starts with # and a Topic Name starts with $.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Match the Topic Filter to that Topic Name.
requirements.why_checkable: A leading-# filter can be matched against a leading-$ Topic Name and the result checked.

requirements.quote: [MQTT-4.7.2-1]	The Server MUST NOT match Topic Filters starting with a wildcard character (# or +) with Topic Names beginning with a $ character.
requirements.condition: When a Topic Filter starts with + and a Topic Name starts with $.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Match the Topic Filter to that Topic Name.
requirements.why_checkable: A leading-+ filter can be matched against a leading-$ Topic Name and the result checked.

requirements.quote: [MQTT-4.7.3-1]	All Topic Names and Topic Filters MUST be at least one character long.
requirements.condition: When constructing or accepting a Topic Name.
requirements.required_behavior: Require at least one character.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Use an empty Topic Name.
requirements.why_checkable: An empty Topic Name can be tested against the minimum length.

requirements.quote: [MQTT-4.7.3-1]	All Topic Names and Topic Filters MUST be at least one character long.
requirements.condition: When constructing or accepting a Topic Filter.
requirements.required_behavior: Require at least one character.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Use an empty Topic Filter.
requirements.why_checkable: An empty Topic Filter can be tested against the minimum length.

requirements.quote: [MQTT-4.7.3-2]	Topic Names and Topic Filters MUST NOT include the null character (Unicode U+0000).
requirements.condition: When constructing or accepting a Topic Name.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Include Unicode U+0000.
requirements.why_checkable: A Topic Name containing U+0000 can be supplied and checked for rejection.

requirements.quote: [MQTT-4.7.3-2]	Topic Names and Topic Filters MUST NOT include the null character (Unicode U+0000).
requirements.condition: When constructing or accepting a Topic Filter.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Include Unicode U+0000.
requirements.why_checkable: A Topic Filter containing U+0000 can be supplied and checked for rejection.

requirements.quote: [MQTT-4.7.3-3]	Topic Names and Topic Filters are UTF-8 encoded strings, they MUST NOT encode to more than 65535 bytes.
requirements.condition: When encoding a Topic Name.
requirements.required_behavior: Encode it as a UTF-8 string.
requirements.why_checkable: The serialized Topic Name bytes can be validated as UTF-8.

requirements.quote: [MQTT-4.7.3-3]	Topic Names and Topic Filters are UTF-8 encoded strings, they MUST NOT encode to more than 65535 bytes.
requirements.condition: When encoding a Topic Name as UTF-8.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Encode it to more than 65535 bytes.
requirements.why_checkable: Its UTF-8 byte length can be calculated and compared with 65535.

requirements.quote: [MQTT-4.7.3-3]	Topic Names and Topic Filters are UTF-8 encoded strings, they MUST NOT encode to more than 65535 bytes.
requirements.condition: When encoding a Topic Filter.
requirements.required_behavior: Encode it as a UTF-8 string.
requirements.why_checkable: The serialized Topic Filter bytes can be validated as UTF-8.

requirements.quote: [MQTT-4.7.3-3]	Topic Names and Topic Filters are UTF-8 encoded strings, they MUST NOT encode to more than 65535 bytes.
requirements.condition: When encoding a Topic Filter as UTF-8.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Encode it to more than 65535 bytes.
requirements.why_checkable: Its UTF-8 byte length can be calculated and compared with 65535.

requirements.quote: [MQTT-4.7.3-4]	When it performs subscription matching the Server MUST NOT perform any normalization of Topic Names or Topic Filters, or any modification or substitution of unrecognized characters.
requirements.condition: When a Server performs subscription matching on Topic Names.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Normalize the Topic Names.
requirements.why_checkable: Canonically similar but byte-distinct Topic Names can be tested for exact matching.

requirements.quote: [MQTT-4.7.3-4]	When it performs subscription matching the Server MUST NOT perform any normalization of Topic Names or Topic Filters, or any modification or substitution of unrecognized characters.
requirements.condition: When a Server performs subscription matching on Topic Filters.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Normalize the Topic Filters.
requirements.why_checkable: Canonically similar but byte-distinct Topic Filters can be tested for exact matching.

requirements.quote: [MQTT-4.7.3-4]	When it performs subscription matching the Server MUST NOT perform any normalization of Topic Names or Topic Filters, or any modification or substitution of unrecognized characters.
requirements.condition: When a Server encounters an unrecognized character during subscription matching.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Modify the unrecognized character.
requirements.why_checkable: Matching input and internal comparison data can be inspected for character mutation.

requirements.quote: [MQTT-4.7.3-4]	When it performs subscription matching the Server MUST NOT perform any normalization of Topic Names or Topic Filters, or any modification or substitution of unrecognized characters.
requirements.condition: When a Server encounters an unrecognized character during subscription matching.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Substitute another character for the unrecognized character.
requirements.why_checkable: Matching results can be compared against exact input characters to detect substitution.

requirements.quote: [MQTT-4.8.0-1]	Unless stated otherwise, if either the Server or Client encounters a protocol violation, it MUST close the Network Connection on which it received that Control Packet which caused the protocol violation.
requirements.condition: Unless another rule states otherwise, when a Server encounters a protocol violation caused by a received Control Packet.
requirements.required_behavior: Close the Network Connection on which that packet was received.
requirements.why_checkable: A protocol-violating packet can be injected and Server connection closure observed.

requirements.quote: [MQTT-4.8.0-1]	Unless stated otherwise, if either the Server or Client encounters a protocol violation, it MUST close the Network Connection on which it received that Control Packet which caused the protocol violation.
requirements.condition: Unless another rule states otherwise, when a Client encounters a protocol violation caused by a received Control Packet.
requirements.required_behavior: Close the Network Connection on which that packet was received.
requirements.why_checkable: A protocol-violating packet can be injected and Client connection closure observed.

requirements.quote: [MQTT-4.8.0-2]	If the Client or Server encounters a Transient Error while processing an inbound Control Packet it MUST close the Network Connection on which it received that Control Packet.
requirements.condition: When a Client encounters a Transient Error while processing an inbound Control Packet.
requirements.required_behavior: Close the Network Connection on which the packet was received.
requirements.why_checkable: A controlled transient processing failure can be induced and Client closure observed.

requirements.quote: [MQTT-4.8.0-2]	If the Client or Server encounters a Transient Error while processing an inbound Control Packet it MUST close the Network Connection on which it received that Control Packet.
requirements.condition: When a Server encounters a Transient Error while processing an inbound Control Packet.
requirements.required_behavior: Close the Network Connection on which the packet was received.
requirements.why_checkable: A controlled transient processing failure can be induced and Server closure observed.

requirements.quote: [MQTT-6.0.0-1]	MQTT Control Packets MUST be sent in WebSocket binary data frames.
requirements.condition: When MQTT is transported over WebSocket.
requirements.required_behavior: Send MQTT Control Packets in WebSocket binary data frames.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Send them in non-binary WebSocket data frames.
requirements.why_checkable: WebSocket opcodes carrying MQTT bytes can be inspected.

requirements.quote: If any other type of data frame is received the recipient MUST close the Network Connection.
requirements.condition: When an MQTT-over-WebSocket recipient receives a non-binary data frame.
requirements.required_behavior: Close the Network Connection.
requirements.error_behavior: Terminate the connection rather than continue MQTT processing.
requirements.why_checkable: A text data frame can be injected and closure observed.

requirements.quote:
[MQTT-6.0.0-2]	A single WebSocket data frame can contain multiple or partial MQTT Control Packets.
The receiver MUST NOT assume that MQTT Control Packets are aligned on WebSocket frame boundaries.
requirements.condition: When one WebSocket frame contains multiple complete MQTT Control Packets.
requirements.required_behavior: Parse and process every contained packet independently of the frame boundary.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Assume one frame contains exactly one MQTT Control Packet.
requirements.why_checkable: Multiple packets can be concatenated into one frame and all actions observed.

requirements.quote:
[MQTT-6.0.0-2]	A single WebSocket data frame can contain multiple or partial MQTT Control Packets.
The receiver MUST NOT assume that MQTT Control Packets are aligned on WebSocket frame boundaries.
requirements.condition: When one MQTT Control Packet is split across WebSocket frame boundaries.
requirements.required_behavior: Reassemble and parse the packet independently of frame boundaries.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Assume every WebSocket boundary is an MQTT packet boundary.
requirements.why_checkable: A valid packet can be divided at arbitrary byte offsets across frames.

requirements.quote: [MQTT-6.0.0-3]	The client MUST include “mqtt” in the list of WebSocket Sub Protocols it offers.
requirements.condition: When an MQTT Client offers WebSocket Sub Protocols.
requirements.required_behavior: Include the exact name “mqtt” in the offered list.
requirements.why_checkable: The offered subprotocol list in the opening handshake can be inspected.

requirements.quote: [MQTT-6.0.0-4]	The WebSocket Sub Protocol name selected and returned by the server MUST be “mqtt”.
requirements.condition: When a Server accepts MQTT over WebSocket and returns a selected subprotocol.
requirements.required_behavior: Select and return the exact name “mqtt”.
requirements.why_checkable: The selected subprotocol in the opening response can be inspected.

requirements.quote: [MQTT-7.0.0-1]	A Server that both accepts inbound connections and establishes outbound connections to other Servers MUST conform as both an MQTT Client and MQTT Server.
requirements.condition: When a Server accepts inbound connections and also establishes outbound connections to other Servers.
requirements.required_behavior: Conform to all applicable MQTT Client requirements for its outbound role.
requirements.why_checkable: The implementation's outbound behavior can be tested against Client requirements.

requirements.quote: [MQTT-7.0.0-1]	A Server that both accepts inbound connections and establishes outbound connections to other Servers MUST conform as both an MQTT Client and MQTT Server.
requirements.condition: When a Server accepts inbound connections and also establishes outbound connections to other Servers.
requirements.required_behavior: Conform to all applicable MQTT Server requirements for its inbound role.
requirements.why_checkable: The implementation's inbound behavior can be tested against Server requirements.

requirements.quote: [MQTT-7.0.0-2]	Conformant implementations MUST NOT require the use of any extensions defined outside of this specification in order to interoperate with any other conformant implementation.
requirements.condition: When interoperating with another conformant MQTT implementation.
requirements.required_behavior: Interoperate without requiring extensions outside this specification.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Make an external extension mandatory for interoperability.
requirements.why_checkable: Two conformant implementations can be tested with all external extensions disabled.

requirements.quote: [MQTT-7.1.1-1]	A conformant Server MUST support the use of one or more underlying transport protocols that provide an ordered, lossless, stream of bytes from the Client to Server and Server to Client.
requirements.condition: For a conformant MQTT Server.
requirements.required_behavior: Support at least one underlying transport protocol.
requirements.why_checkable: The Server's supported transport set can be enumerated and exercised.

requirements.quote: [MQTT-7.1.1-1]	A conformant Server MUST support the use of one or more underlying transport protocols that provide an ordered, lossless, stream of bytes from the Client to Server and Server to Client.
requirements.condition: For each transport used by a conformant Server, in the Client-to-Server direction.
requirements.required_behavior: Provide an ordered byte stream.
requirements.why_checkable: Distinct byte sequences can be sent and receive order compared.
